title: 'BTS ARMY: Forever We Are Young' Documentary Opens in Theaters Worldwide
detail: July 30, 2026 — The fan documentary 'BTS ARMY: Forever We Are Young,' directed by Grace Lee and Patty Anh, opens in theaters worldwide via Trafalgar Releasing. The film follows ARMY members across continents, blending personal stories with the fandom's global milestones to explore the passion, creativity, and activism that built BTS into a global phenomenon rather than focusing on the group itself. Tickets went on sale July 2 through the film's official site, with select cinemas offering branded concessions and exclusive posters.

media.caption: 'BTS ARMY: Forever We Are Young' opens in theaters worldwide, spotlighting the fandom's global impact.
